expectations.text: 用 Open Transition (Break-Before-Make, BBM) / Open Transition (BBM) 与 Closed Transition (Make-Before-Break, MBB) / Closed Transition (MBB)，缩写 BBM/MBB 原样保留不译
expectations.evidence: Body L7: "break-before-make (BBM) and make-before-break (MBB)" — omits required head terms "Open Transition" / "Closed Transition" in the transfer modes sentence (only uses "closed-transition transfer" in sentence 2).

expectations.text: 规范性动词「应」译为 shall（如 shall ensure），不用 should 或 must
expectations.evidence: Body L11: "The mechanical interlock mechanism shall ensure that the two power sources cannot be closed simultaneously."

expectations.text: 「恢复转换延时」译为 return transfer delay（可附 RTD），不用笼统 time delay
expectations.evidence: Body L7: "and the return transfer delay can be set within the range of 0 s to 180 s."

expectations.text: 保留 100 ms / 1.5 s / 0 to 180 s（或 0–180 s），但明确标注这些时间参数未经对应型号数据表核实（IEC 60947-6-1 只定类别不定时间）
expectations.evidence: L31-38 only discuss SI spacing, range formatting, and boundary fidelity; zero caveat that 100 ms / 1.5 s / 0 s to 180 s are unverified against a datasheet or that IEC 60947-6-1 does not fix timing values.

expectations.text: 保持 Track 2 说明书语体（完整规范性条款句式，未混入 Track 1 样本册营销压缩话术）
expectations.evidence: Body L5-11 uses numbered manual clauses (4.3, 4.4) and normative manual prose ("does not exceed", "is no greater than", "shall ensure").

expectations.text: 数字与单位之间严格有单个半角空格（100 ms / 1.5 s / 180 s），且正文无残留中文全角标点
expectations.evidence: Body L7: "100 ms", "1.5 s", "0 s to 180 s" — single half-width spaces and no full-width punctuation in English body.
